Sandbox_Extinction.NaturalStarvation_too: New worlds only. Replaces the fixed extinction deadline with a biological-reserve simulation. Zombies weaken over time, benefit from rain, and may feed on existing human, zombie, and animal corpses. They never attack living zombies for food. When enabled, Days until complete zombie extinction is ignored and locked. Existing fixed-timeline saves keep their original mode after updating.
Sandbox_Extinction.HuntAnimals_tooltip: Independent of Natural extinction: works in either mode when selected for a new world. Ordinary zombies pursue and bite living animals. In natural mode, they may feed on the resulting corpses. Zombies never hunt other living zombies. Existing fixed-timeline saves keep their original behaviour after updating.
Sandbox_Extinction.ExtinctionDays_toolti: Used only when natural calorie distribution is disabled. Every ordinary zombie receives one permanent random death date between the beginning of the apocalypse and the end of this period. The standard Months Since the Apocalypse setting is respected. A value of 0 causes immediate extinction. Project A-Life characters are not affected.
Sandbox_Extinction.SkeletonizationDays_t: After this many days, an ordinary zombie corpse is replaced with a lightweight, unidentifiable skeleton. Preservable hard loot is transferred to the remains. Standard corpse-removal settings still apply. A value of 0 disables automatic skeletonization.
Sandbox_Extinction.TestShowBiologicalSta: Testing aid, disabled by default. Shows a compact reserve, estimated survival time, and current biological state above nearby active zombies.
Sandbox_Extinction.TestShowCorpseNutriti: Testing aid, disabled by default. Shows the remaining raw resource and assimilable reserve-days above nearby corpses.
